input.quote: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
input.rationale: The cap is mutual, indirect damages are mutually excluded, and the Excluded Claims definition (21.3) carves out confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, with payment obligations excluded from "damages" — all compliant. However the quantum is illusory: "Fees" is defined in 1.5/1.6 as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the cap is effectively USD 12,000 rather than 12 months' fees. Redlined to the greater of all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement in the preceding 12 months and USD 1,000,000.

input.quote: If any invoice is not paid within ten days of its due date, Customer shall pay Vendor, as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to fifteen percent of the annual Fees for each week the invoice remains unpaid.
input.rationale: Section 7.7 imposes liquidated damages payable by Customer at 15% of annual Fees per week of delay, which is punitive, potentially unlimited in aggregate, and inconsistent with our right to withhold disputed amounts under 7.3. Our position is no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer; deleted, with simple interest on undisputed overdue amounts offered as the fallback.
